sources: Dynasty League Football 2027 SF Rookie Mock (Sep 2026)
PFF 2027 big board, positional rankings and stock reports

players.name: Jeremiah Smith
players.note: Consensus No. 1 prospect on PFF, ESPN and DraftSharks boards; opened 2026 with 8 catches and 2 TDs vs. Ball State.

players.name: Arch Manning
players.note: Dual-threat QB and frequent mock No. 1 pick; threw 4 TDs in the 2026 opener but was outdueled by John Mateer.

players.name: Dante Moore
players.note: Early QB1 favorite of ESPN-polled evaluators; struggled in the Week 2 loss to Oklahoma State but rebounded with 3 TDs vs. Penn State.

players.name: Darian Mensah
players.note: Miami transfer who has surged into the QB1 conversation; 14 TD passes and zero INTs through four games with an ACC completion-streak record.

players.name: Julian Sayin
players.note: PFF's early QB1 after leading FBS QBs in PFF grade in 2025; threw for 320 yards and 3 TDs in the 2026 opener.

players.name: CJ Carr
players.note: Kiper's No. 2 QB and a DLF mock 1.03; earned an 89.3 PFF grade in Week 5 with the fastest release on PFF's board.

players.name: Jadan Baugh
players.note: Violent runner and Heisman-buzz back; had about 600 yards and 11 TDs through four games before a loss at Missouri.

players.name: Cam Coleman
players.note: Auburn transfer and DLF mock 1.02; Footballguys notes he has not yet delivered the expected 2026 breakout.

players.name: Drew Mestemaker
players.note: North Texas transfer and the top 2026 riser; beat Oregon with 317 passing and 109 rushing yards, and Daniel Jeremiah calls him the most intriguing QB.

players.name: Kewan Lacy
players.note: Brugler's RB1 entering 2026; has battled thigh and left-shoulder injuries this season.

players.name: Charlie Becker
players.note: 6-foot-4 receiver ranked WR3 by Jordan Reid and 11th in DraftSharks' superflex board after 679 yards in 2025.

players.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
players.note: High-ceiling receiver ranked WR3 by Matt Miller; drops have remained a concern early in 2026.

players.name: LaNorris Sellers
players.note: Elite athlete with inconsistent passing; rough Alabama loss but a 4-TD win at Florida revived his stock.

players.name: Trinidad Chambliss
players.note: Sixth-year QB who won eligibility in court; Kiper's early QB1 and Jeremiah's favorite QB to watch despite 6-0, 205 size.

players.name: Ahmad Hardy
players.note: PFF's early RB1, but recovering from a May 2026 gunshot wound to the leg and has not played this season.

players.name: Bryant Wesco Jr.
players.note: Separator with 1,245 career yards; slow 2026 start with 16 catches for 163 yards through late September.

players.name: Trey'Dez Green
players.note: Preseason AP first-team All-American and consensus TE1/TE2; injured in Week 3 with a possible return around Week 10.

players.name: Isaac Brown
players.note: Top-five RB on Matt Miller's list and 18th in DraftSharks' superflex rankings.

players.name: Nate Frazier
players.note: Georgia's lead back after 947 yards in 2025; high-ceiling runner, per Footballguys dealing with a minor injury.

players.name: Mark Fletcher Jr.
players.note: Senior power back ranked RB2 by PFF and 19th in DraftSharks' superflex rankings.

players.name: TJ Moore
players.note: 837-yard 2025 producer ranked 19th by DraftSharks; 21 catches for 196 yards early in 2026 amid Clemson QB changes.

players.name: Jamari Johnson
players.note: Traditional inline-capable tight end ranked TE1 by CBS and ESPN's Miller and Reid.

players.name: Ryan Wingo
players.note: Led Texas with 834 yards in 2025; posted 7-121-1 in the 2026 opener.

players.name: Jayden Maiava
players.note: 6-foot-4 returning starter ranked QB6 on B/R's board after 23 TDs in 2025.

players.name: John Mateer
players.note: Gritty dual-threat QB with turnover questions; slow start in 2026 but outdueled Arch Manning.

players.name: KJ Duff
players.note: 6-foot-6 contested-catch specialist highlighted by PFF and CBS evaluators.

players.name: Justice Haynes
players.note: Senior back in Brugler's top five running backs.

players.name: Nyck Harbor
players.note: Rare size-speed athlete ranked WR4 by NFL Draft Bible.

players.name: Duce Robinson
players.note: Big-bodied receiver in NFL Draft Bible's WR top five and Roto Street Journal's superflex mock.

players.name: Raleek Brown
players.note: Explosive back on Matt Miller's top-five RB list.

players.name: Terrance Carter Jr.
players.note: Productive but undersized (6-2, 245) tight end ranked TE3-TE5 by most boards.

players.name: Peter Clarke
players.note: Led all FBS tight ends with a 90.5 PFF grade in 2025; TE4 on PFF and ESPN lists.

players.name: Reed Harris
players.note: Contested-catch transfer flagged as a PFF stock riser in 2026.

players.name: Caleb Odom
players.note: Big receiving tight end who appears on DraftSharks' 2027 board.

players.name: Luke Reynolds
players.note: Walter Football's TE6 in its September 2026 update.

players.name: Jeremiah Hasley
players.note: Walter Football's TE7 in its September 2026 update.

players.name: Decker DeGraaf
players.note: Appears in ESPN analysts' top-five 2027 tight ends.

players.name: DJ Vonnahme
players.note: Appears in ESPN analysts' top-five 2027 tight ends.
